name: animatedline
setup: h = animatedline; for k = 1:10; addpoints(h, k, k * 2); end;
expr: [xv, yv] = getpoints(h); xlast = xv(end); ylast = yv(end); xfirst = xv(1); n = length(xv);
comment: animatedline + addpoints + getpoints round-trip. After 10 addpoints calls of (k, 2k), getpoints should round-trip the same data. Real numerical fingerprint — not just display invariance.
